definition: MEAN Capstone Project is a core concept in MEAN Stack. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What MEAN Capstone Project is
theory.body: MEAN Capstone Project describes the methods and patterns used within MEAN Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: MEAN Capstone Project is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why MEAN Capstone Project matters
theory.body: Without MEAN Capstone Project, systems built with MEAN Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How MEAN Capstone Project works
theory.body: The mechanism behind MEAN Capstone Project follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of MEAN Capstone Project.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of MEAN Capstone Project
theory.body: MEAN Capstone Project offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
